title: VM Holding launches the MokenLogic Harness for macOS preview
summary: The MokenLogic website has entered trial operation and the Harness for macOS preview is now available to download.
paragraphs: VM Holding Company Limited announced that the website for its artificial-intelligence product brand MokenLogic entered trial operation on 1 September 2026, alongside the release of the MokenLogic Harness for macOS preview.

MokenLogic focuses on continual-learning agents and the application layer above foundation models. It is designed to embed AI into content-asset operations, brand interaction and enterprise workflows for users, businesses and IP creators.

Harness aims to help agents carry out long-running tasks, use tools and retain inspectable evidence of their work. The group plans to validate the product first in its own IP operations before gradually opening service interfaces to partners.
The macOS preview is initially intended for creators, content teams and knowledge workers, with further product and enterprise-service iterations planned around early usage.

title: VM Holding plans AI and continual-learning joint venture with Gauss Tech
summary: The parties plan to establish a Hong Kong joint venture bringing application-layer AI to existing IP content and real operating scenarios.
paragraphs: VM Holding Company Limited and Gauss Technology (Hong Kong) Company Limited entered into an investment cooperation agreement on 28 August 2026 to establish a limited-liability joint venture in Hong Kong.

The collaboration is intended to expand the group's artificial-intelligence and continual-learning activities by turning its application-layer strategy into user-facing products grounded in existing IP content and real operating scenarios.

The joint venture plans to provide AI system software through PaaS and SaaS models, helping users and IP creators assemble business scenarios more quickly. The arrangement remains subject to definitive agreements and the conditions described in the company's announcement.

title: VM Holding reports 168.24% revenue growth for the 2026 interim period
summary: First-half revenue increased to approximately HK$62.0 million, led by the group's IP application and product business.
paragraphs: VM Holding reported interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. Revenue increased by 168.24% year on year to approximately HK$62.022 million, while gross profit rose by 169.96% to approximately HK$7.907 million.
Loss attributable to owners of the company narrowed by 58.87% to approximately HK$17.546 million, with a loss per share of HK1.85 cents.

Revenue from IP application and product activities increased by 1,821.3% to approximately HK$44.767 million, reflecting contributions from the group's broader operating portfolio and product delivery.
The group will continue connecting technology, IP and real-world scenarios while executing its business-development and investment plans with appropriate discipline.

title: VM Holding's Chengdu precious-metals joint venture commences operations
summary: The Chengdu joint venture has opened and obtained trading qualification from the Shanghai Gold Exchange.
paragraphs: VM Holding announced that its wholly owned subsidiary Beijing 1520 Technology Company Limited and Beijing Xiuman Technology Company Limited established Chengdu Tianhexinrui Precious Metals Company Limited in Chengdu. The joint venture has commenced operations and obtained trading qualification from the Shanghai Gold Exchange.

The company is applying for international board membership of the Shanghai Gold Exchange. The board believes a successful application would help connect domestic and international markets and support a more complete business model built on the group's experience in sports and IP operations.
The group plans to combine sports IP, including LaLiga and Manchester United, with a range of commemorative gold products. The programme will explore links between digital assets and physical gold.
The board expects the 2026 FIFA World Cup and subsequent sporting events to support demand for products combining the value attributes of precious metals with the collectability of sports IP.
The group will continue to pursue its strategy of connecting technology, IP and real-world experiences to support long-term shareholder value.

For the LaLiga programme, the group's wholly owned Tianji New Consumption Technology Company Limited and Xizulian Technology Development (Beijing) Company Limited formed Tianji Xizulian (Beijing) Technology Development Company Limited in September 2025. The joint venture has registered capital of RMB1 million, and the group initially held a 20% interest.

The collaboration covers the development, design, production and sale of physical and digital products, themed commercial experiences, smart terminals, member communities and membership-benefit products.

The group proposes to contribute a further RMB640,000. On completion, its interest in the joint venture will increase to 51.22%, and the joint venture's results will be consolidated into the group's financial statements.

title: VM Holding receives Most Promising Investment Company award
summary: The company received the award at the 10th Zhitong Finance Listed Company Awards.
paragraphs: On 3 December 2025, VM Holding (01520) received the Most Promising Investment Company award at the 10th Zhitong Finance Listed Company Awards.

The award recognises Hong Kong and US listed companies with strong growth prospects and long-term investment potential. Its assessment considers business models, growth outlook, earnings momentum and valuation appeal.

The selection process considered company submissions, multi-dimensional data screening and expert review across business growth, industry position, corporate governance, market returns and ESG performance.
The company said the recognition reflects capital-market confidence in its growth potential and long-term strategy.
